## Build command
```
cd /tmp/sv-effb2084df4e4b85950845cb0181993f/before && dotnet clean -q 2>/dev/null && dotnet build -p:IsAotCompatible=true 2>&1 | grep "IL[0-9]" > /tmp/aot-warnings.txt
```

## Current warnings (180 total)

Here are all the unique warning sources and what needs to be fixed:

### 1. csproj - Add IsAotCompatible
File: `Azure.ResourceManager.csproj`
Add `<IsAotCompatible>true</IsAotCompatible>` to the PropertyGroup.

### 2. ArmClientBuilderExtensions.cs (lines 30) - IL2026/IL3050
The method `AddArmClient` with `TConfiguration` calls `RegisterClientFactory` which has `RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute` and `RequiresDynamicCodeAttribute`.
Fix: Add `[RequiresUnreferencedCode]` and `[RequiresDynamicCode]` attributes to the method itself (propagate the warning).

### 3. ArmEnvironment.cs (line 80) - IL2026/IL3050
`ToString()` calls `JsonSerializer.Serialize(this)`.
Fix: Add `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("AotAnalysis", "IL2026:...")]` and `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage("AotAnalysis", "IL3050:...")]` to the ToString method. Use `System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis` namespace.

### 4. ArmOperation.cs (lines 96-111) - IL2090/IL2087
`IsResource<T>()` method uses `typeof(T).GetConstructor(...)` and `Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(T), ...)`.
Fix: Add `[DynamicallyAccessedMembers(DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.NonPublicConstructors)]` to the `T` generic type parameter of `IsResource<T>()` method. You'll need to import `System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis`.

### 5. ArmClientOptions.cs (line 52) - IL2026/IL3050
`SetApiVersionsFromProfile` uses `JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, JsonElement>>>()`.
Fix: Add `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage]` attributes to `SetApiVersionsFromProfile` method for both IL2026 and IL3050.

### 6. GenericOperationSource.cs (lines 37, 40) - IL2087
The class `GenericOperationSource<T>` uses `ModelReaderWriter.Read(response.Content, typeof(T))` (needs `PublicConstructors | NonPublicConstructors`) and `Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(T), ...)` (needs `NonPublicConstructors`).

For the Serialization.cs files, add `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage]` attributes on the methods that contain calls, OR use `#pragma warning disable IL2026, IL3050` at the top of each file before the class definition.

Since many of these are auto-generated code with many call sites, the most practical approach is to add `#pragma warning disable` at the top of the file (after the existing pragmas if any). This is the standard Azure SDK approach for generated serialization code.

For each `.Serialization.cs` file that has warnings, add these lines near the top of the file (after the copyright header and any existing `#nullable disable`):
```csharp
#pragma warning disable IL2026 // Members annotated with 'RequiresUnreferencedCodeAttribute' require dynamic access otherwise can break functionality when trimming application code
#pragma warning disable IL3050 // Calling members annotated with 'RequiresDynamicCodeAttribute' may break functionality when AOT compiling
```
